skills.name: release-bundle-preparation
skills.description: Prepare and validate a public release bundle for a sample project: evidence, compatibility data, checksums, semantic version and rollback instructions.
useCases: Package my project as a public release with checksums and rollback steps
Promote my preview release to stable and validate the release metadata
Check that my release bundle has version, license and evidence files
What do I need before I publish v1.0.0 of this starter kit?

skills.name: public-asset-license-review
skills.description: Review the licenses of source code, models, datasets, binaries and documents before a project is distributed publicly, and flag anything that cannot be redistributed.
useCases: Can I publish this model checkpoint with my project?
Review the licenses of my new Python dependency before I add it
List every asset in my release bundle and its license
Check which files in this repo must not be redistributed

skills.name: device-readiness
skills.description: Check whether a publicly available Qualcomm development board is ready for a documented project workflow: reachable, identified, correct OS image and required tools present.
useCases: Is my dev board ready to run this sample?
Check that my board is reachable and running a supported OS image before I deploy
What is missing on my device for this workflow?
Validate my hardware target before I publish the demo
